questions.question: Inme se kaunsa number **rational** hai?
questions.explanation: √(49/16) = 7/4, jo p/q form mein hai, isliye rational hai. √12 = 2√3 aur π/2 irrational hain, aur 0.1010010001... ka decimal na terminate hota hai na repeat, isliye woh bhi irrational hai.

questions.question: f: ℝ → ℝ, f(x) = 3x − 4 ek bijective function hai. f⁻¹(11) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: f⁻¹(11) woh x hai jiske liye f(x) = 11: 3x − 4 = 11, to x = 5. 29 = f(11) hai (galat direction), aur 1/29 isliye galat hai kyunki f⁻¹ ka matlab 1/f nahi hota.

questions.question: Equation x² − 6x + k = 0 ke roots **real aur distinct** hain. k ki saari possible values kaunsi hain?
questions.explanation: Real aur distinct roots ke liye discriminant > 0: 36 − 4k > 0, yani k < 9. k ≤ 9 galat hai kyunki k = 9 par roots equal ho jaate hain.

questions.question: 120 students ke survey mein 70 ko Cricket pasand hai, 55 ko Football, aur 25 ko dono mein se koi nahi. Kitne students ko **exactly ek** game pasand hai?
questions.explanation: Kam se kam ek pasand = 120 − 25 = 95. Dono = 70 + 55 − 95 = 30. Exactly ek = 95 − 30 = 65. 95 "kam se kam ek" hai aur 40 sirf Cricket wale hain.

questions.question: A = {1, 2, 3} par relation R = {(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (1, 2), (2, 1), (2, 3)} hai. R ke baare mein kya sahi hai?
options: Reflexive aur symmetric, par transitive nahi
Reflexive aur transitive, par symmetric nahi
questions.explanation: Teeno (a, a) maujood hain, to reflexive. (2, 3) hai par (3, 2) nahi, to symmetric nahi. (1, 2) aur (2, 3) hain par (1, 3) nahi, to transitive bhi nahi.

questions.question: Points (2, −1) aur (−4, 7) se guzarne wali line ka **y-intercept** kya hai?
questions.explanation: Slope = (7 − (−1))/(−4 − 2) = −4/3. Line: y + 1 = −4/3 (x − 2), yani 4x + 3y − 5 = 0. x = 0 rakhne par y = 5/3. 5/4 x-intercept hai aur −4/3 slope hai.

questions.question: Parallel lines 6x − 8y + 7 = 0 aur 3x − 4y − 9 = 0 ke beech ki distance kitni hai?
questions.explanation: Doosri line ko 2 se multiply karo: 6x − 8y − 18 = 0. Distance = |7 − (−18)| / √(6² + 8²) = 25/10 = 2.5. Bina coefficients match kiye |7 + 9|/10 = 1.6 aata hai, jo galat hai.

questions.question: Ek ball ki height (metre mein) t second baad h(t) = −5t² + 30t + 8 hai. Ball kitne second tak zameen se **48 m ya usse upar** rehti hai?
questions.explanation: −5t² + 30t + 8 ≥ 48 ⇒ t² − 6t + 8 ≤ 0 ⇒ (t − 2)(t − 4) ≤ 0, yani 2 ≤ t ≤ 4. Duration = 4 − 2 = 2 second. 4 sirf bada root hai, aur 3 woh time hai jab ball maximum height (53 m) par hoti hai.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa variable **continuous numerical** hai?
options: Ek ghar mein rehne wale logon ki sankhya
Ek athlete ka 100 m race ka time (seconds mein)
questions.explanation: Time ek measurement hai jo kisi bhi decimal value ko le sakta hai, isliye continuous numerical hai. Logon ki sankhya discrete hai, T-shirt size ordinal categorical hai, aur mobile number sirf ek label hai.

questions.question: 80 logon se unka travel mode poocha gaya: Bus 28, Metro 20, Car 12, aur baaki sab Bike. Bike ki **relative frequency** kya hai?
questions.explanation: Bike = 80 − (28 + 20 + 12) = 20. Relative frequency = 20/80 = 0.25. 20 sirf frequency hai, aur 0.35 Bus ki relative frequency hai.

questions.question: Data 4, 8, 8, 3, 10, 8, 5, 6 ka **median** kya hai?
questions.explanation: Sort karo: 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 8, 8, 10. n = 8 even hai, to median = (6 + 8)/2 = 7. 8 mode hai aur 6.5 mean hai.

questions.question: Sample data 3, 7, 7, 9, 14 ka **sample standard deviation** (n − 1 se divide karke) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Mean = 40/5 = 8. Squared deviations: 25, 1, 1, 1, 36, sum = 64. Sample variance = 64/4 = 16, to SD = √16 = 4. 16 variance hai (SD nahi), aur 3.58 = √(64/5) population SD hai.

questions.question: Sorted data: 12, 15, 18, 18, 22, 25, 27, 31, 31, 40, 75. 1.5 × IQR rule ke hisaab se **upper fence** kya hai?
questions.explanation: Q1 = 18 aur Q3 = 31, to IQR = 13. Upper fence = Q3 + 1.5 × 13 = 31 + 19.5 = 50.5, isliye 75 outlier hai. 44 = Q3 + IQR (1.5 bhool gaye) aur 44.5 = median + 1.5 × IQR.

questions.question: Ek app ke 200 users ki table: Android — Premium 30, Free 90; iOS — Premium 32, Free 48. Kaunsa statement sahi hai?
options: iOS users mein Premium ka proportion 0.40 hai, jo Android (0.25) se zyada hai
Premium users mein iOS ka proportion 0.40 hai
iOS users mein Premium ka proportion 0.16 hai
Dono groups mein Premium ka proportion same hai, isliye koi association nahi
questions.explanation: iOS total = 32 + 48 = 80, to 32/80 = 0.40; Android total = 120, to 30/120 = 0.25. Proportions alag hain, to association hai. 0.16 = 32/200 (poore total se divide) aur Premium users mein iOS = 32/62 ≈ 0.52 hai, 0.40 nahi.

questions.question: x: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 aur y: 2, 4, 5, 4, 10. Correlation coefficient r lagbhag kitna hai?
questions.explanation: x̄ = 3, ȳ = 5. Σ(x − x̄)(y − ȳ) = 16, Σ(x − x̄)² = 10, Σ(y − ȳ)² = 36. r = 16/√(10 × 36) = 16/18.97 ≈ 0.84. 3.2 covariance (16/5) hai, aur 1.6 slope hai; r kabhi 1 se zyada nahi ho sakta.

questions.question: 5 values ka mean 10 aur **population variance** 4 hai. Baad mein pata chala ki ek value 14 galti se likhi gayi thi; sahi value 6 hai. Sahi population variance kya hai?
questions.explanation: Σx = 50 aur Σx² = 5 × (4 + 10²) = 520. Correct karne par Σx = 42, Σx² = 520 − 196 + 36 = 360. Naya mean = 8.4, variance = 360/5 − 8.4² = 72 − 70.56 = 1.44. 1.2 SD hai, aur 1.8 n − 1 se divide karne par aata hai.

questions.question: Pile 1 ke cards par Age is order mein hai: 15, 22, 18, 30, 17, 25. Pseudocode chalne ke baad `count` ki value kya hogi?
questions.code:
count = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Age >= 18:
        count = count + 1
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: Condition `X.Age >= 18` 22, 18, 30 aur 25 ke liye True hai, to count = 4. 3 tab aata jab condition `>` hoti (18 chhoot jaata), aur 6 bina filter ke saare cards hain.

questions.question: Ek record ke kis field ka **average** nikalna meaningful hai?
questions.explanation: Bill amount ek actual quantity hai, uska sum aur average ka matlab banta hai. Roll number, PIN code aur route number digits se bane hain par sirf labels hain, unka average meaningless hai.

questions.question: Neeche ka pseudocode chalne ke baad `q` aur `r` ki values kya hongi?
questions.code:
a = 4
b = 9
p = (a * 2 > b)
q = not p or (b - a == 5)
r = p and q
questions.explanation: a * 2 = 8, aur 8 > 9 False hai, to p = False. q = not p or (5 == 5) = True or True = True. r = p and q = False and True = False.

questions.question: Cards (Category, Amount) is order mein hain: (Food, 120), (Travel, 300), (Food, 60), (Books, 250), (Travel, 90), (Food, 200). Pseudocode ke baad `total` kya hoga?
questions.code:
total = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Category == "Food" or X.Amount > 250:
        total = total + X.Amount
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: Food cards: 120 + 60 + 200 = 380. Amount > 250 wala non-Food card sirf Travel 300 hai (250 > 250 False hai). Total = 380 + 300 = 680. 930 tab aata jab `>=` hota, aur 0 tab jab `or` ki jagah `and` hota.

questions.question: Is flowchart ka output kya hoga?
questions.code:
Start
n = 1, s = 0
[Decision] s < 30 ?
    Yes: s = s + n * n
         n = n + 1
         go back to Decision
    No:  Output n
End
questions.explanation: Trace: s = 1, n = 2 → s = 5, n = 3 → s = 14, n = 4 → s = 30, n = 5. Ab 30 < 30 False hai, to output n = 5. 4 aakhri baar add kiya gaya n hai, par n uske baad bhi ek baar badh chuka hai.

questions.question: Cards (Name, Marks) is order mein hain: (Asha, 72), (Bilal, 85), (Chitra, 85), (Dev, 64). Pseudocode ke baad `name` kya hoga?
questions.code:
best = 0
name = "None"
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Marks >= best:
        best = X.Marks
        name = X.Name
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: `>=` ki wajah se barabar marks par bhi update hota hai: Asha (72) → Bilal (85) → Chitra (85, kyunki 85 >= 85). Dev 64 par kuch nahi badalta. Bilal tab aata jab condition `>` hoti.

questions.question: Ek shehar ke daily Temp cards is order mein hain: 31, 34, 36, 33, 37, 38, 39, 30. Pseudocode ke baad `c` kya hoga?
questions.code:
prev = 0
c = 0
while Pile 1 has more cards:
    Pick a card X from Pile 1
    if X.Temp > prev and X.Temp > 32:
        c = c + 1
    prev = X.Temp
    Move X to Pile 2
end while
questions.explanation: c badhta hai jab Temp pichle din se zyada ho aur 32 se bhi zyada ho: 34, 36, 37, 38, 39 → c = 5. Pehla card 31 > 0 hai par 31 > 32 False hai, isliye 6 galat hai. `prev` har card par update hota hai, condition ke bahar.

questions.question: N = 2753 ke liye is flowchart ka output kya hoga?
questions.code:
Start
Read N
s = 0, k = 0
[D1] N > 0 ?
    No:  Output s, k → End
    Yes: d = N % 10
         [D2] d % 2 == 1 ?
             Yes: s = s + d
             No:  k = k + 1
         N = (N - d) / 10
         go back to D1
questions.explanation: Digits right se aate hain: 3 (odd, s = 3), 5 (s = 8), 7 (s = 15), 2 (even, k = 1). Phir N = 0 aur loop rukta hai. 17 saare digits ka sum hai, jabki even digit 2 sirf k mein gina jaata hai.

questions.question: Kis word mein letter 'b' **silent** hai?
questions.explanation: 'thumb' ko 'thum' bola jaata hai; final 'mb' mein b silent hota hai. rubber, bulb aur about mein b clearly bola jaata hai.

questions.question: Word 'celebration' mein kitne syllables hain?
questions.explanation: ce-le-bra-tion: chaar vowel sounds, isliye 4 syllables. '-tion' ek hi syllable hai (shun), do nahi.

questions.question: Sentence 'She is afraid of the dark.' mein word 'dark' kaunsa part of speech hai?
questions.explanation: Yahan 'the dark' ek cheez (andhera) ka naam hai aur preposition 'of' ka object hai, isliye noun. 'a dark room' mein yahi word adjective hota.

questions.question: Sahi verb form chuno: "I ___ this novel for two hours, and I am still not done."
questions.explanation: 'for two hours' + abhi bhi chal raha action = present perfect continuous: 'have been reading'. 'am reading' mein past se ab tak ki duration nahi aati, aur 'had read' past ke kisi aur point ki baat karta hai.

questions.question: Kis word mein stress **third** syllable par hai?
questions.explanation: en-gi-NEER mein stress teesre syllable par hai. BEAU-ti-ful mein pehle par, pho-TOG-ra-pher aur im-POR-tant mein doosre par.

questions.question: Kis word mein 'th' **voiced** sound hai (jaise 'this' mein)?
questions.explanation: 'mother' ka 'th' voiced hai, 'this' jaisa. think, thank aur bath mein 'th' voiceless hai, jaise 'thin' mein.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsa sentence grammatically correct hai?
options: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
She has visited Jaipur last year.
By next June, they will have finished the bridge.
questions.explanation: 'By next June' future ke ek point se pehle poora hone wala kaam hai, isliye future perfect sahi hai. 'If' clause mein future ke liye simple present aata hai (If it rains), 'last year' ke saath simple past aata hai (visited), aur 'know' stative verb hai jo continuous mein nahi aata.

questions.question: Sentence 'Since the shop was closed, we came back home.' mein words 'since' aur 'back' kramashah (respectively) kaunse parts of speech hain?
questions.explanation: 'since' yahan ek poore clause (the shop was closed) ko jod raha hai, to conjunction hai; 'since Monday' mein yeh preposition hota. 'back' verb 'came' ko modify karta hai (kahan aaye), isliye adverb hai.
